question.text: Which of the following diagrams correctly shows the relation between the terminal velocity $\mathrm{v}_{\mathrm{T}}$ of a spherical body falling in a liquid and viscosity $\eta$ of the liquid?

solution.text:
Hint : At terminal speed.
$\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{T}}=\frac{2 \mathrm{r}^{2}}{9 \eta}\left(\rho_{\mathrm{s}}-\rho_{\mathrm{L}}\right) \mathrm{g} \quad$ (Assuming other factor constant)
So, $\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{T}} \propto \frac{1}{\eta}$ (rectangular hyperbola)
